# Source of Truth Reconciliation

## Runtime truth
- active config
- gateway/runtime state
- host/process/service reality
- actual channel and agent behavior

## Durable knowledge truth
- Ultimate Wiki pages
- canon docs
- operations pages
- chronicle/review/recall pages

## Conversational surfaces
- Discord and other chats
- command surfaces, not final truth by themselves

## Rule
Chats initiate, clarify, and steer.
Durable pages preserve.
Runtime proves.
